described_as: The owner's mixed folder. A sorting agent divides it into piles in a private repository; this agent reads the pile for the Duska line and the pile for both lines (rulings X-019, X-020). At private commit 2e9dd04 the Duska pile was empty and the shared pile held one file. The pile is the sorter's label: a prior, not evidence. At private commit 4f16658 the Duska pile held four files: a gravestone photograph, a marriage register page of 1892, a screenshot of the Senné baptism register in an online viewer, and a page of burials of 1831 to 1841. At b9e7b06 three more: a census household (image kept), a page from an online family tree (held unopened) and a newspaper print of 1911 (held; transcribed in part). At 31b6cf5 one more: a cemetery record of a Duska born 28 Nov 1890. At 2bea03e nine more: a Québec declaration of marriage of 1984 (held) and eight photographs of the 1937 emigration papers of Maria Duska and her son.

Given in four parts as 'Inacovce - Reformed Catholic', 45 files. The owner called the fourth part final. Baptism entries from a Reformed (Calvinist) register for Solymos, the Hungarian name of Iňačovce, 1825 to 1921. Whether it sits under 'Duska Baptisms' on his desktop was not said.
Given as 'Presov - Greek Catholic FULL', 4 files. Baptisms from the Greek Catholic parish of Eperjes (Prešov), 1804 to 1822, in Latin. No Duska.

Given in eight parts as 'Senne - Roman Catholic', 95 image files, with one text document that is held unopened. Closed by this agent on the owner's word to judge as it saw fit: his file names run from 'Andras' to 'Zsuzsanna' and end with the volume's first page. Baptism entries from the Roman Catholic register of Senné (Szenna; Ungszenna by 1906), 1866 to 1912.
One image strip, marked '[full]' by the owner: the baptism of an Anna Krak at Sztára (Staré) in January 1848.

Announced by the owner as 'Beginning Duska Census'. Part 1, '1767 - Urbanarium': eight images of urbarial tables for Solymos (three pages, one of them twice), Szenna (two pages), Csicser and Viszoka (one page each), with one word-processor file held unopened. More parts are expected. Part 2, '1869 Solymos Census Full': four census household sheets as photographs of a screen, four screenshots of them, and six files not published (four compiled pages unopened; a third party's transcription; the archive file). Part 3, '1921 Census Folder': two maps of Ung county and a guide to the 1921 census (held, summarised); census pages are expected to follow. Part 4, '1930 - BESA Whole Folder': one household sheet of the 1930 census, a Schwarcz family of Beša. Parts 5 and 6, '1930 Senne' (15 sheets) and '1930 Senne Second Pass' (20 enlargements and portal pages). Parts 7 to 15, the 1930 census for Čičarovce (4), Iňačovce (18), Maťovce (3), 'Mogyoros' (2), Palín (1), Pavlovce (1), Veľké Kapušany (3), Veľké Slemence (1) and Vysoká (13), read at B-037. Part 16, '1940 Senne' (12). Five 'Initial List' word files held unopened. Part 17, 'Transcarpathian': one household sheet of the census of [1921] for Nižní Domanince by Uzhhorod, a Durkota family filed as 'Dusko or Duska'. Fourteen more word files: nine held unopened, five opened and found to be web-link lists and search counts. The owner ended the folder with these.

Announced by the owner as the next folder, 'one file', 'non-exhaustive', with the remark that the Places agent might want to know. A land register print-out of 2022 for a house and garden at Senné owned by a couple named Duška, kept by him to document the name at Senné. Shown de-identified on his instruction: no given names, no address, no register numbers.

Announced by the owner as 'Duska Death Folder', beginning with the sub-folder 'Belza Kosice Greek Catholic', marked full: nine burial strips, eight of them Demko and Kocsis, one a D[u]ska of Galicia. Sub-folder 'Cicarovce - Greek Catholic', in two parts, complete: eighteen burial strips, [1831] to 1883, sixteen Demko and two Kocsis, all routed to the Demko agent. More sub-folders are expected. Sub-folder 'Inacovce Greek Catholic', four parts, final: 46 burial strips, 1812 to 1897: Krak (21), Demko, Kocsis and their kin (15), Duska or Dusko (8), and two Danko strips filed under other names. Sub-folder 'Inacovce - Reform Catholic', two parts, final: 25 burial strips from the Reformed book of Solymos, 1830 to 1926: 22 Duska or Dusko, two Kocsis and one Szalontai. Sub-folder 'Montreal', marked full: three screenshots of a society's index to Montréal cemeteries (Mary Demko 1950, 'Mikalis' Duska 1965, Mike Duska 1974), published as crops. Sub-folder 'Senne - ROCA', nine parts: 96 burial strips from the Roman Catholic book of Senné, [1831] to 1924: Duska (43), Nyemcsik (29), Demko (12), Kocsis (11) and one Krak by the owner's file names; eight of them carry a name on the strip that is not the one in the file name. The owner closed the folder on 13 Nov 2026 (S-000-15): 197 documents in six sub-folders. On the same day he added 'that's all for deaths for now' (S-000-16): closed for the present; later deaths, if he sends any, reopen it.

Announced by the owner as 'DUSKA RANDOM WHOLE FOLDER': seven full openings of the Senné Roman Catholic baptism book (1879 to 1907), a two-row passenger-list strip, a screenshot of a message from Notre-Dame-des-Neiges cemetery, and a word file named for DNA that was not opened.

Announced by the owner as 'New random ass folder called Duska documents part 1': the obituary of Štefan Duska (2018), a sheet of an index to arrivals of 1937, a second copy of the marriage registration of 1955, and two voters' lists. Part 2: baptism cuts of 1852, 1890 and 1903, two captures of a Québec death index, four copies of files archived before, and a researcher's notes (held).
